description: Deprecated language codes and one compound CLDR language alias as filenames, chosen so the two rewriting layers can be told apart: the JDK rewrites iw/in/ji, CLDR would rewrite sh (to sr-Latn), tl (to fil), mo (to ro), cmn (to zh) and aa-Saaho (to ssy), and only the first layer runs at load. Load-only.
